_comment: Sample per-domain benchmark quality scores (0-1) for the candidate pool in config/models.yaml, keyed 'provider/model_id' (provider lowercased to match config/pricing/<date>.yaml). These are illustrative placeholder numbers for the sample build pipeline -- NOT real benchmark output. In the real pipeline (T068/release gate) this file is produced by OmnisBench running each candidate model against the labeled dataset and is versioned alongside the dataset it was measured against. See routing/BUILD.md.
